constraints: Digits 1-9, no repeated digit within a trial at ANY length (length 9 = a permutation of 1-9), no adjacent pair differing by 1, two trials per length with different first and last digits, no sequence reused across forms or between forward/backward; one unscored practice trial each.

Length 2 used only for 2 practice trials; scored lengths 3-8 x 2 trials. Digit/letter composition, first-item category and position pattern are identical by slot in all forms; within-category inversions fixed at ceil(n(n-1)/4); letters from FHJKLMRSXY; no trial reused across forms.

Numbers 13-96. Lists 1 and 2: each final digit exactly 3 times (9/30 tens-crossings each); List 3: 15 '+' items with 4 crossings and 15 '-' items with 4 crossings. Identical tens/units multisets in every form, so list means are identical. No duplicates within a list, no adjacent equal or consecutive numbers, no more than 2 crossing items in a row. Each list on its own page with practice items.
No letter shared across forms (FAS / BHR / PMT); 'animals' at every occasion; alternating pairs contain common nouns only; fixed English response language.

90 study-written sentences + 4 shared practice items; all gaps sentence-final; one expected word per sentence; no expected word repeated in the battery; no stem contains another same-form item's expected word; length and target frequency balanced across the six form x part cells. Pending cloze norming.

100 items per page in 5 x 20 columns; exact 34/33/33 colour counts; no immediate word or ink repetition in reading order; CW ink never equals word (0% congruent); CW words follow the W-page word order; 5-item practice row per page; colour-naming check before the task; restart-from-top rule removes the ceiling.

Part A 1-25, Part B 1-A-...-L-13 (no 'End' target; 'Begin'/'End' printed as small labels under the first and last circles). No path crossings, circle centres >= 20 mm apart, every path segment >= 8 mm from other circle centres; six test layouts selected from a seeded pool to match path length (+/-2%), turning, distractor proximity; sample trails for A and B.
Official 14-item ADEXI, unchanged wording, official 1-5 scale and scoring (WM 9 items, Inhibition 5 items); administered at T0 (optional T2), not at every occasion.
